title: 換
teacherNotes: Production B lesson-local asset-complete-package for L221. Latest origin/main production curriculum is complete through L215, so L216-L220 are provisional dependencies unless already merged by the time Release integrates this package. Production owns request, packet, draft, images, audio, Stage 4 audio, alignment, fast local validation, registry status, and pushed package branch. Release owns production JSON insertion, planner export, ledger update, registry cleanup after merge, final verify, push to main, and deployment.

generationConstraints.allowedBoundary: latest origin/main L001-L215 learned chars plus provisional learned chars ["身","濕","乾","服","褲"] plus current target "換"
imageRules: Generate square image / 1:1 composition for each sentence.
Use L058 lesson images only as illustration style references; do not copy any L058 person, clothing, face, hair, or body shape.
Use protagonist family identity anchors from L154/L162/L163 for protagonist little girl, protagonist mother, and protagonist father.
Use public/assets/reference/lesson-cast/godmother.webp as the recurring protagonist godmother visual identity reference for L221-S03.
Mother, father, teacher, godmother, and other adults must be visually distinct.
No written text, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, watermarks, logos, brands, battery symbols, readable funeral/religious text, or readable marks.
Each image must clearly match its approved image notes and remain phone-readable in a square crop.
audioRules: Use repo OpenAI audio flow only.
Generate G02 prefix/suffix and G05 wrong-option audio as standalone whole-text files from exact text.
Do not splice, cut, mute, patch, or extract production audio.

approvedSentences.text: 衣服褲子都濕了，快去換掉。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 衣服褲子都濕了快去換掉
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩在家門口或浴室外安全區域，衣服和褲子都被雨水弄濕，主角媽媽提醒她快去換掉。畫面只呈現濕衣褲和被提醒的情境，不呈現更衣過程；不可有文字、數字或標籤。
喪禮或安靜告別會現場，主角小女孩穿著一身紅衣服，主角媽媽溫和提醒她換掉；周圍成人穿深色衣服、氣氛安靜莊重。畫面要靠服裝顏色和場合氣氛表達，不可出現牌位文字、宗教文字、喪禮標語、數字、標籤或可讀文字。

Use the approved recurring protagonist godmother / 乾媽 reference asset: public/assets/reference/lesson-cast/godmother.webp. She is a very tall adult woman in the protagonist girl's trusted family-friend circle, clearly taller than 我媽媽 and 老師, warm but crisp, with short or neat medium-length hair and a deep green or blue-green long jacket/top. Do not make her look like 媽媽 or 老師; no yellow/coral-red mother palette, no classroom clothing, no book, no pointer, no teaching posture. 畫面中主角小女孩站在乾媽旁邊，明顯看出乾媽身高很高；不可有文字、數字或標籤。
主角爸爸和主角小女孩在家中看著一個沒電的小玩具，旁邊有需要更換的乾電池。主角爸爸準備把舊乾電池換掉。畫面要清楚表現電池沒電要換，但玩具或電池上不可有文字、數字、品牌或標籤。

approvedSentences.text: 外面天氣很冷，去換長褲。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 外面天氣很冷去換長褲
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角媽媽在家中提醒主角小女孩，外面天氣很冷，要去換長褲；窗外可有冷風吹樹葉或陰冷天氣，主角小女孩手上或床上有長褲。畫面只呈現準備換衣的安全情境，不呈現更衣過程；不可有文字、數字或標籤。

G01.reason: 「換掉」是本課核心動詞用法，目標字清楚。
